name: codex-orchestration
description: Nested Terra orchestration with root-only experience verification.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.8.18 preserves the direct root fast path for ordinary read-only follow-ups and adds a root-to-child workspace dependency handoff for spreadsheet, presentation, document, and PDF work. Root loads the bundled artifact runtime once, then passes its exact executable and package paths through Terra to the selected implementer, preventing child tasks from failing because the root-only dependency loader is unavailable in their tool catalog. Mutation, fresh verification, audits, and substantial research still route through the fused GPT-5.6 Terra / Max orchestrator. Continuity carries a bounded recent-conversation window and marks an older completion capsule stale when newer root conversation exists. Ambiguous continuation commands must resolve to an exact recent decision. Acceptance contracts name concrete outcomes, destinations, and open commitments; build supervisors independently compare them with the user request and recent context before implementation. Read-only fallback work stays silent until its single final answer, supervisor checkpoints render as readable Markdown, and Remaining can be None only after every explicit commitment has decisive proof. Six specialized companion profiles preserve fixed routes, serial checkpoint handoffs, root-only experience verification, and conflict-safe installation.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat tweak/build routing with checkpoint supervision.
